title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to enhance your experience and streamline your workflow.

title: Effortless File Management
summary: Easily upload, manage, and customize how your images and documents appear in the editor, putting you in complete control of your content.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to effortlessly track our progress, discover upcoming features, and explore our long-term vision.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved task management experience with our newly designed checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and seamlessly draggable.

title: Enhanced Real-Time Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with our newly refined collaboration features, making shared editing more intuitive and efficient.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared items from your network, making teamwork more productive and connected.

title: Introducing Multilingual Support
summary: Get ready for a truly global experience as Noeko introduces comprehensive support for diverse international languages.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: Experience unprecedented transparency and control as Noeko's codebase becomes fully open source, empowering our community to shape its future.

title: Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Explore your knowledge base more effectively with powerful new filters, including tags, time windows, and shared items, making the Constellation View a truly dynamic workflow starter.

title: Precision Search & Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly discover and organize your knowledge with enhanced filtering and sorting capabilities, allowing you to instantly save focused sets of information as custom collections for quick access.

title: Flexible Content Display
summary: Organize your notes more intuitively with new flexible content display options that allow for enhanced previews and interaction with linked information.

title: Noeko: Take Control with Self-Hosting and Advanced Plans
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko with the freedom of self-hosting and the benefits of our new premium plans, designed to elevate your productivity.

title: Stunning New & Enhanced Themes
summary: Prepare for a beautiful visual refresh with significantly improved existing themes and an exciting array of new options to personalize your workspace.

title: Precise Time-Based Welcome
summary: Enjoy a perfectly timed welcome on your homepage, as we refine our greetings to accurately reflect your local time and enhance your personalized experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Management with Bulk Actions
summary: Now you can quickly remove and manage multiple items directly within any tag's view, dramatically improving your workflow efficiency.

title: Expand Your Knowledge with New Content Sources
summary: Unlock a world of information by seamlessly integrating diverse content formats like YouTube videos, websites, and text files directly into your workspace for comprehensive engagement.
